status: DEFAULT (pipeline.DEFAULT_PORTFOLIO_CONFIG, ADR 0071). Written before any evolve strategy has reached the portfolio stage (0 VALIDATION_SURVIVOR in every recorded context) and without looking at any market-data portfolio result. v1 stays loadable and unchanged. A change needs a new versioned file and an ADR.
note: Separate from promotion_v5.json: promo-v5 (the individual-strategy criteria) is unchanged. This is an ADDITIONAL veto layer: a VALIDATION_SURVIVOR (= PASS_INDIVIDUAL) enters a locked campaign and promotion only with portfolio_status PASS_PORTFOLIO. Passing it is a necessary condition about account risk, never evidence of an edge (the members were selected on the same validation window).
data: validation window of each member symbol (already read by the StepM batch and robustness of these members). Never the locked TEST window, IW0/IW1 or any sealed data.

composition.rule: standalone (the candidate alone) AND joint (the candidate + the book). Book = strategies of the same experiment context whose latest portfolio record is PASS_PORTFOLIO and whose current status is not REJECTED, INCONCLUSIVE or PAPER_FAILED. Members sorted by strategy id; equal weights; no weight is fitted to data.

stress_partial_latency.note: diagnostic only: fill_ratio = share filled at the decision's entry open, the remainder fills at the next open with its own price and cost (cancelled if that is at/after the exit); latency = entry 1 bar later with the exit re-derived from the strategy's own exit rule. Uncalibrated (no real fills exist).

max_gross_exposure: sum of entry notionals / equity at the entry open (not multiplied by leverage): 1.0 at 1x, 3.0 for the 3x stress
thresholds_source: base and cross 3x: portfolio.PORTFOLIO_PASS_CRITERIA (final equity > initial, MDD < 0.5, 0 liquidations, not bankrupt) and the promo-v5 validation minima (30 events, 30 days); ADR 0071 adds no new numeric threshold: 0 data-missing signals (no tolerance) and null (undefined) refusal limits.

checks_v2.max_drawdown_close_lt: v1 max_drawdown_lt renamed: drawdown of the equity at bar closes (same number, same meaning).
checks_v2.max_drawdown_intrabar_lt: same account-level limit 0.5 applied to the worst-case intrabar drawdown (every open long at its low, short at its high at one moment; isolated floored at -margin). Stricter than the close drawdown by construction (worst case <= close equity), never a relaxation. Status not OK (stale marks, < 2 bars) -> UNDETERMINED_PORTFOLIO.
checks_v2.require_signal_accounting: the evaluator diagnostics of every member/symbol must be present and every signal must land in exactly one bucket (signals_total = entered + rejections + strategy-rule + window-end); else UNDETERMINED_PORTFOLIO.
checks_v2.max_data_missing_signals: 0: a signal that could not be priced (no traded value / cost error) or funded (funding coverage, settlement gap, unknown schedule) has an unknown outcome; any such signal -> INSUFFICIENT_PORTFOLIO_DATA. Zero is not a tuned number: any positive tolerance would be an unjustified choice.
checks_v2.max_cost_refusal_share: null = no preregistered limit exists (none in promo-v1..v5, portfolio-validation-v1 or the NEW2 ADRs). With null, ANY participation-cap refusal (evaluator at the research order size or account at the actual notional) makes the scenario UNDETERMINED_PORTFOLIO instead of PASS. A numeric limit needs a new version and an ADR with a source, written before results are seen.
checks_v2.max_capital_refusal_share: null, same rule for margin / gross-exposure / concurrent-position / same-symbol / zero-allocation refusals: real constraints of running the members together on one account; reported per reason with its denominator, never passed without a limit.
checks_v2.rates_denominator: execution_candidates = signals_total - strategy_rule (evaluator non-overlap, duplicate signal, inactive member) - window_end (exit or delayed fill beyond the data). Rejections: cost_refused, data_missing, capital, halted.

stress_cross_3x_risk: Cross 3x now has the same account-level drawdown limits as base (close 0.5, intrabar worst case 0.5). Relation to the risk policy: the only preregistered account-loss limit in this repository is portfolio.PORTFOLIO_PASS_CRITERIA max_drawdown_lt 0.5 (equity, not notional); it is a limit on the ACCOUNT's loss and does not depend on leverage, so the leveraged stress is held to the same account limit rather than a leverage-scaled number. A stricter cross-specific limit has no source in the repository and is not invented; the minimum equity / maintenance-margin ratio is recorded as a diagnostic (metrics.min_equity_to_maintenance_ratio), not gated.
